result.summary: Found several visual issues: a critical untranslated localization key as a section title, truncated restaurant names, and a partially cut-off category chip.

issues.description: Section heading displays the raw localization/key string 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the proper translated string (e.g. 'Popular near you') and ensure fallbacks so keys never show in the UI.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off at the edge of the card in the 'Fastest near you' row.
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on a second line / tooltip so the full name is readable.

issues.description: The last category filter chip ('Healthy') is partially clipped off the right edge of the screen, suggesting overflow without enough scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll padding or peek of the next chip so users can tell the list is scrollable; avoid clipping labels.

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card (pizza) is cut off mid-image by the bottom navigation, which can look unfinished on first paint.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the tab bar height so cards aren't obscured when scrolling ends.
